scope: V.05 UI port. No physics/storage/input/renderer/catalog/audio changes. GL stub for DOM contracts; real WebGL + worker for existing transitions; SwiftShader for temporal visual evidence and UI performance. Camera and inference are synthetic in hand tests.
limitations: Physical webcam, touch device, gamepad and sensors were not tested in this port.
No hardware GPU FPS or memory certification.
Gecko, WebKit and screen readers remain unverified.
CSS zoom is a test approximation, not native text zoom.
No new Windows package or release was produced for V.05.
